evaluation: 2018 observed development; no independent holdout claim
K_selection: No selection: K6 is primary for all architectures; K12/24 mean-only are registered single-seed sensitivities
controls: exact-parameter self control for each of the five history architectures
core: Matched original raw/no-channel residual + ordinary learned normalized MCC32; no Qwen or text features
point_initialization: Cold-start all models from matched declared seeds; no A2 model weights reused
neighbor_scope: Strict event_time<target; no equal-time, cross-user, cross-card, development training nodes or neighbor labels
transformer: one historical layer, four heads, width64/feedforward128, fixed sinusoidal position, padding masked
GRU: one layer, width64, oldest-first valid observations; pack lengths excludes padding
loss: Fully supervised weighted BCE; positive logit-gradient factor20, negative1, mean over all rows
schedule: Fixed cosine decay from0.001 to0.00005 over12 epochs; no development early stopping
resources: One sequential CPU training process; report wall time, inference, whole-process peak and tensor/model sizes; not isolated hardware benchmark
selection: All registered final epochs and all seeds included; no architecture or K chosen as unseen-test result
